snippet.title: Eternal Afternoon | Amazing Retro Nostalgic End Of The World Game | PC
snippet.description:
Eternal Afternoon | Amazing Retro Nostalgic End Of The World Game | PC
#newgame #gameplay #gaming #indiegame #nostalgia #apocalypse 

Buy Game - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3924170/Eternal_Afternoon/

Eternal Afternoon is a poetic walking sim about wasting time before the end of the world. You play as Sasha, a 10-year-old boy wandering his neighborhood in the final minutes before a giant black wave swallows everything.



Retro nostalgic visuals & authentic atmosphere – a suburban block in the summer of 2001, recreated with care.

A chilling meditation on time, death, and the inevitable – experience the quiet dread of a world that ends in twenty minutes.

Story through exploration – uncover small moments, side quests, and fragments of mystery woven into the neighborhood.

Built with replayability and speedrun in mind – no save system, no upgrades; your only progress is knowledge of how the world works and how everything connects.
